context: Two friends gossip at the cafe about a star going solo
purpose: Teach: 占い/セッション/ジャンプ/コミック/萌え/歌手/ソロ/クロス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ聞いた？あの人気歌手、ついにソロ活動を始めるんだって。
lines.en: Hey, did you hear? That popular singer is finally starting solo activities.
lines.style: Excited romantic whisper leaning across the cafe table

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うそ、マジで？この前ライブで縦ジャンプしながら歌ってた、あの子でしょ？
lines.en: No way, seriously? That's the girl who was vertical-jumping while singing at her live, right?
lines.style: Surprised barista pausing mid-pour with wide eyes

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そうそう、ファンの間では萌えキャラみたいに可愛いって有名な子だよ。
lines.en: Yeah, yeah, she's famous among fans for being cute like a moe character.
lines.style: Eager gossip voice nodding rapidly with delight

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ファン雑誌のコミック風イラスト特集、私持ってるよ、可愛かった。
lines.en: I actually own that fan magazine's comic-style illustration feature of her — she looked adorable.
lines.style: Smiling barista leaning in conspiratorially while drying a cup

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そういえば今朝の星座占いで「大きな転機」って出てて、彼女のこと思い出した。
lines.en: Speaking of which, this morning's horoscope said 'big turning point' and I thought of her.
lines.style: Animated friend gesturing with both hands above the latte

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 占い当たってるかもね、次の録音セッションは完全に一人らしいよ。
lines.en: The fortune might be right — apparently her next recording session is completely solo.
lines.style: Intrigued barista raising an eyebrow while resting on the counter

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 他のメンバーとのコラボ、いわゆるクロスオーバー企画はもう無しなのかな。
lines.en: I wonder if collabs with the other members — those so-called crossover projects — are off the table now.
lines.style: Wistful romantic tone stirring her coffee with a small frown

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でも一人で歌う方が絶対伸びるよ、私の勘がそう言ってる。
lines.en: But singing alone will definitely let her grow more, my gut tells me so.
lines.style: Confident barista nodding firmly while wiping her hands on her apron
